Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 25-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIRST SEMESTER M.TECH. EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Data Analytics and Visualization [CSS_5113]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                   Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Apply your understanding of data analytics to compare and contrast the key methods-Descriptive,       (5)  
  Diagnostic, Predictive, and Prescriptive Analytics-and explain how organizations choose the  
  A)           appropriate method based on project objectives and data types.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Explain the concept of Data Segmentation and describe why it is significant in data analytics         (3)  
  projects.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)           List any two advantages of density-based clustering methods and describe why they are useful in       (2)  
  data analysis.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2)                Demonstrate the difference between structured and unstructured data using Python with suitable        (5)  
  examples.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Explain the concept of Hypothesis Testing in Data Analytics and interpret the purpose of each step    (3)  
  involved in the process.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)           What are the two main types of interestingness measures. Explain with examples.                       (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3)                Analyze the concept of Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and evaluate its role in identifying patterns, (5)  
  detecting anomalies, and improving decision-making in data analytics projects.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Apply your understanding of statistical inference to explain the concept of a confidence interval and (3)  
  illustrate its practical use in real-world data analysis.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  
  Page #1

C)                Explain the Gestalt Principle of Similarity and describe how it helps viewers interpret visual            (2)  
  information effectively, with a suitable example.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
4)                        Analyze how the Apriori Algorithm identifies frequent itemsets and association rules, and evaluate        (5)  
  its strengths and limitations using an example.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Justify the role of the Visualization Reference Model in designing effective visualizations and justify (3)  
  its application using a Python-based visualization.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)                Summarize the importance of perception techniques in designing effective and meaningful data              (2)  
  visualizations  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5)                        Evaluate and compare the effectiveness of graph and tree structures in data visualization,                (5)  
  highlighting their strengths, limitations, and suitable use cases.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Evaluate the role of interaction and visualization techniques in enhancing data interpretation.           (3)  
  Support your answer with a suitable Python example.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)                Explain why data structures are important in data visualization and how they support effective visual (2)  
  representation of information.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  
  -----End-----
